intent: How full the prompt context is and what uses the space, by segment, with a warning near the limit and Trim oldest. Compact form for a header.
useWhen: show a thread's context usage next to a chat or agent
warn before old messages are trimmed
doNotUseWhen: plan or billing usage — UsageList or a usage meter
a generic progress value — Meter or Progress

segments.note: { id, label, tokens }[] in display order; up to five categorical fills from existing roles.

compact.note: One line: kit Meter, used / limit, status icon.

onTrim.note: Trim oldest (outline when near limit or full, ghost otherwise).

requirements: the stacked bar is role=meter with min, max, now and a text value
near limit and full are text and an icon, not colour alone
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local ContextMeter or TokenBar
Do not pass a percent as used
Do not signal near-limit by colour alone
snippet: <ContextWindow used={104000} limit={200000} segments={[{ id: "system", label: "System", tokens: 6200 }, { id: "messages", label: "Messages", tokens: 58600 }]} onTrim={trim} />
